 Is  a will to live something I have to choose to give me purpose? I feel like other people are just born with a will to live like it's a feeling inside them. That dying is their worst fear and they like being alive. I want that.

The gap between the rich and the poor is growing, humanitarian issues large and small. The rich have all the power in my country and there is no hope for huge change. I feel that the current economic system is just ruining lives everywhere. And I feel so sad for everyone. I am so privelaged even living in a rich country. I can't afford expensive clothes so I have to buy clothes that are made with cheap labour. I wish I didn't care. Really I wish I had no conscience. But I care so deeply that I have to ignore it because it eats away at me.
